name: oauth.v2.completeShortTokenRotation
purpose: Call this to finish rotating the secret on an old API token with a short secret. Must be paired with a call to oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation to start the process.

client_id.desc: Issued when you created your application. Must be the app the token being rotated was issued to.

client_secret.desc: Issued when you created your application.

new_token.desc: The new xoxp token returned by oauth.v2.beginShortTokenRotation.
